steps.text: Open the checklist scheduled for your store.
Select the relevant department if prompted.
Answer every required question using the response control configured for the question.
Add comments or evidence when required.
Review the progress indicator.
Tap Finish/Complete and confirm any signature requirement.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_start-inspection.title: How to start an inspection in a store

steps.text: From the checklist or inspection area, select your store and the checklist.
Choose Routine check for the planned recurring inspection.
Select Special inspection for an ad-hoc inspection outside the routine schedule.
Complete the same question flow and finish the run.
Special inspections are reported separately from routine checks.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_attach-photo-eviden.title: How to attach a photo as evidence when answering a checklist question

steps.text: On the question, tap the camera/photo control.
Choose Camera or Gallery.
Capture/select the image.
Confirm the image.
Save the answer.
Let the image upload during synchronization before deleting it from the device.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_sync-data.title: How to sync data in MCL

steps.text: Reconnect to the internet.
Return to the home screen or pull to refresh/reopen the app.
Use the available Sync/Update action if your version shows one.
Sign out and back in only after pending offline work has synchronized.
Contact the administrator to verify your market, role, and checklist assignments.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_enable-notification.title: How to turn on task notifications

steps.text: Allow notifications for MCL in the phone operating-system settings.
Keep the app updated.
Ask the administrator to check the task notification configuration and your assigned device/account if you do not receive reminders.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_assign-task.title: How to assign a task to a coworker

steps.text: Create or edit the task.
Select the target market and choose one or more users assigned to that market.
Save the task.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_mark-task-done.title: How a coworker marks a task as done

steps.text: Open the task from Tasks.
Complete the requested work.
Add a note/evidence if required.
Use the completion/close action.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_daily-routine.title: Typical daily routine in the app

steps.text: Open MCL after connecting to the network.
Check whether today’s data has refreshed.
Review Tasks for due or overdue items.
Run the scheduled routine checklists for your store/department.
Record accurate answers and evidence at the point of work.
Submit completed checklists and complete assigned tasks.
Reconnect if necessary before leaving.
Confirm that the app has synchronized.
Resolve any failed uploads or pending items.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_view-inspection-res.title: How to see the results of inspections

steps.text: Open Reports/Checklist History in the mobile app to view completed runs and their answers.
Use Reports and Data Analysis/Dashboard on the web for filtered, aggregated results.
Apply available filters commonly including time period, market group, checklist group, and checklist.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_open-dashboard.title: How to open the dashboard on the web

steps.text: Open https://marktcheckliste.de/ in a browser.
Sign in with your MCL account.
Use the company-provided branded or test URL if instructed.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_export-inspection-r.title: Export Inspection Results to Excel or PDF

steps.text: Open the completed run from Reports/History.
Use the PDF/download option when available.
If Excel export is needed, check if it is enabled for your role or tenant configuration.
If no export control is present, ask the administrator to provide the report or enable the appropriate permission.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_log-in-to-mcl-app.title: How to log in to the MCL app for the first time

steps.text: Install the MCL app supplied by your company.
Open the app with an internet connection.
Enter the email/username and password issued to you.
Sign in.
Accept notification permission if you want task alerts.
If authentication fails, confirm the account has been created and assigned to a company/market.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_reset-password.title: How to reset your password if you forget it

steps.text: Use the Forgot password option on the MCL web sign-in page.
Enter the email address registered for your account.
Follow the email reset link.
Create a password that meets the company policy.
Ask your company MCL administrator to verify the account email and reset access if you do not receive the email or no reset option is shown in the app.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_add-new-user.title: How to add a new user from your company to MCL

steps.text: Open the web administration area (typically Companies/Users).
Create or invite the user with their name and email.
Assign the user to the company.
Choose the role for the user.
Assign the relevant markets/departments.
Have the new user sign in and synchronize the app.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_change-app-language.title: How to change the app language

steps.text: Use the language option in the app/profile/settings if your version exposes it.
Restart or refresh the app after changing the language.
Ask an administrator for help if the setting is not available to your role.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_create-recurring-ch.title: How to make a checklist repeat automatically

steps.text: Create a recurring checklist using the Checklist Wizard/configuration permission.
Set its periodicity and weekday/time-related rules.
Assign the target markets/departments and roles.
Save the checklist.

mcl-user-guide-qa-en_checklist-wizard-st.title: How to use the Checklist Wizard step by step

steps.text: Open Checklists > Checklist Wizard and choose Add (or copy an existing checklist).
Enter the general setup: name, recurring/periodicity settings, signature requirement and any relevant tags or groups.
Add departments and decide whether users may select a department.
Add questions, choose each question type and configure options, sequence, evidence/sensor settings and required behavior.
Assign the roles and markets that may run the checklist; configure notifications/email rules if required.
Preview the checklist, verify the assignments and complete/save it.
Synchronize a test device and run a test inspection before production use.
